**STEP 1 — Scene:** A chicken and avocado salad with mixed leafy greens and a few red onion slices.

**STEP 2 — Vessel:** A large oval, shallow bowl, approximately 28 × 23 cm. Using an equivalent circular diameter of about 25.4 cm gives an area of **507 cm²**.

**STEP 3 — Items:** Cooked chicken breast pieces, avocado slices, mixed salad leaves, and red onion. No clearly identifiable oil or dressing, so none is added.

**STEP 4 — Area:** Assigning non-overlapping shares of the bowl area: chicken 40%, avocado 22%, leaves 21%, onion 2%. Total: **85% covered**, with about 15% exposed bowl.
